profile_text.body:
WeRide Inc. describes itself as a leading, commercial-stage global company that develops autonomous driving technologies from Level 2 to Level 4. Its website says it operates the WeRide One universal autonomous driving technology platform, a self-developed foundational toolchain, and what it calls an industry-leading accumulation of real-world operational data. The company states that its business footprint spans more than 60 cities across 13 countries, and that it offers a portfolio of five core products, including Robotaxi.

WeRide is listed on Nasdaq under the ticker WRD and on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange under 0800, according to its site. The company's records list it as a public, for-profit company headquartered in Guanzhou, with CIK 0001867729. The site also states that WeRide was recognized in Fortune's 2025 Change the World and 2025 Future 50 lists.

No lawsuits or MCP servers are associated with WeRide. The company is also recorded under the alias WERIDE INC-ADR.
